evals.prompt: Start a coding session and keep my Mac awake for 45 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Convert 45 minutes to 2700 seconds and start detached `/usr/bin/caffeinate -dimsu -t 2700`; report the approximate local end time. Mention that closing the lid or manually sleeping/shutting down can still interrupt it. Do not use `pmset sleepnow` or claim success if the command could not be run.
